preconditions.description: The number of queries q is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(q)])
preconditions.description: For each query, the length of the array n is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(q) for n in [int(input().split()[0])])
preconditions.description: For each query, each element a_i in the array is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(q)]) <= 3 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of all n over all queries does not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The number of results matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(r, int) for r in result)
all(0 <= r <= n * (n + 1) // 2 for r, n in zip(result, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(q)]))
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum number of subarrays of the corresponding array.

postconditions.expression: all(r == sum(1 for start in range(n) for end in range(start + 1, n + 1) if is_stack_exterminable(a[start:end])) for r, n, a in zip(result, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(q)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(q)]))
postconditions.description: Each result is the count of stack exterminable subarrays of the corresponding array.
